messages.text:
I’ve created a refund proposal for both travel pieces for **BRL 208.00**. The records show both were received back (refund-policy/v2/return), and the amount is what was paid for them (refund-policy/v2/amount). Confirm it using the button on the proposal card; a chat message won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).

Typing “stop” won’t cancel it. If you want to cancel, use the cancel button on the card (refund-policy/v2/approval).
